selection.leptons: exactly one tight+isolated electron and one tight+isolated muon, pT >= 25 GeV, ATLAS eta acceptance, opposite charge
selection.jets: at least two jets with pT >= 25 GeV and |eta| < 2.5
selection.b_tag: at least one jet with DL1dv01 continuous quantile >= 2 (85% working-point bin)

physics_status: These are reconstructed lab-frame controls in simulated ttbar events. They are not D and are not corrected to particle level.
